metrics.label: Database tables
metrics.command: grep -oE 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS [A-Za-z_]+' services/claims-api/app/schema.py | sort -u | wc -l
metrics.note: match the table name, not the phrase - a comment in schema.py also contains it, so a plain grep -c over-counts

metrics.label: API routers / endpoints
metrics.command: ls services/claims-api/app/routers/*.py | grep -v __init__ | wc -l; grep -rhoE '@router[.](get|post|put|patch|delete)[(]' services/claims-api/app/routers/*.py | wc -l
metrics.note: character classes instead of backslash escapes to stay valid JSON

metrics.label: Field registry attributes
metrics.note: the DB is the source, seeded from seed.py FIELDS. Do NOT count config/field-registry.json - it is vestigial (Architecture.md 8.2)

metrics.label: Backend tests
metrics.command: cd services/claims-api && python -m pytest --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+ tests collected' | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'
